# Deathclaws Pet Package/Bundle

![Deathclaws Pet Package / Bundle](/uploads/708_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In addition to the free "Infestations" update for Fallout 76, the Deathclaw as a CAMP pet is now not available in the Atom Shop, but in a separate package. This bundle contains all possible Deathclaw gear and CAMP items.

## Description

Get a cuddly, carnivorous companion in Fallout 76 with the Deathclaw Pet Pack! Impress your friends and give your pet Deathclaw a nice home with items like the “Do Not Pet Deathclaw” sign.

Requires Fallout 76 main game (sold separately).

## Content

- 
Deathclaw pet
- 
Claw sharpener
- 
Viscera bowl
- 
Ocher Plating (Deathclaw)
- 
Steel plating (Deathclaw)
- 
“Do not pet Deathclaw” sign
